dosa.name: Daoist Sorcerer
dosa.description: A master of Qi manipulation and Daoist Arts. Uses spells, summons, and DoT effects.
dosa.mechanic: Qi Mastery: Manipulate Qi directly to draw cards and gain buffs. Completing a Sijo recovers 1 extra Qi via the Heavenly Qi passive.

mugwan.name: Military Officer
mugwan.description: A seasoned warrior commanding combat tacticss and allies. Excels at burst damage through Qi.
mugwan.mechanic: ally: Absorbs 1 hit then vanishes, recovering 1 Qi on death. Qi (max 10) carries between turns and powers up attacks.

mungwan.name: Scholar Official
mungwan.description: A learned official wielding knowledge as a weapon. Accumulates knowledge to unleash powerful techniques.
mungwan.mechanic: Each class uses Qi (energy) to play cards.

qi.name: Qi
qi.desc: Energy resource. Recovered each turn (base 3/turn). Used to play cards.

block.name: Block
block.desc: Reduces incoming damage this turn. Lost at turn start.

gold.name: Gold
gold.desc: Currency. Used in shops to buy cards and relics.

burn.name: Burn
burn.desc: At end of turn, take damage equal to Burn stacks. Decreases by 1 each turn.

poison.name: Poison
poison.desc: At end of turn, take damage equal to Poison stacks. Decreases by 1 each turn.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: At start of turn, take fixed curse damage. Expires after set duration.

weaken.name: Weakened
weaken.desc: Next attack deals 25% less damage. Decreases by 1 after triggering.

vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
vulnerable.desc: Take 50% more damage from attacks. Decreases by 1 each turn.

surrounded.name: Surrounded
surrounded.desc: Attack damage reduced by 25%. Lasts set duration.

dismissed.name: Dismissed
dismissed.desc: Attack power reduced by 3. Lasts 3 turns.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.desc: Take damage equal to Bleed stacks at turn end. Decreases by 1 each turn.

strength.name: Strength
strength.desc: All attacks deal +1 damage per Strength stack.

M001.name: Evasion
M001.effect: Gain 4 Block. If you have already played a card this turn, gain 3 more Block.
M001.effect_upgraded: Gain 5 Block. If you have already played a card this turn, gain 4 more Block.
M001.flavor: Step aside from the blade's edge — deflecting is mightier than blocking.

M002.name: Leap
M002.effect: Gain 3 Block. The next Attack card you play this turn deals +4 damage.
M002.effect_upgraded: Gain 4 Block. Next Attack deals +6 damage.
M002.flavor: Spring off the ground — as you rise, your enemy loses sight of your blade.

M003.name: Retreat
M003.effect: Gain 2 Block. Apply 1 Weakened to a target enemy.
M003.flavor: Falling back is no flight — it is a stratagem to bleed the enemy's strength.

M004.name: Flank Strike
M004.effect: Deal 10 damage. If you have any Block, deal 5 more damage.
M004.effect_upgraded: Deal 14 damage. If you have Block, deal 7 more damage.
M004.flavor: Drop low and press the flank — no gap, no guard.

M005.name: Low Crawl
M005.flavor: Hug the earth, slip from view — and ready the next move.

M006.name: Preemptive Strike
M006.flavor: The one who strikes first wins — seize the initiative and shift the tide.

M007.name: Defensive Stance
M007.flavor: Lower your stance, raise your guard — nothing shall pass.

M008.name: Quick Read
M008.flavor: Read the room in an instant — any hand falls into place.

M009.name: Seize the Moment
M009.effect: Draw 1 card. The next card you play this turn costs 1 less (min 0).
M009.effect_upgraded: Draw 2 cards. Next card costs 1 less.
M009.flavor: Opportunity comes only to the prepared — never miss the fleeting instant.

M010.name: Endure
M010.flavor: Stand firm no matter the storm — unyielding resolve is the greatest defense.

M011.name: Exuberance
M011.effect: Draw 1 card. This card can be placed in any Sijo slot.
M011.effect_upgraded: Draw 2 cards. Can be placed in any Sijo slot.
M011.flavor: When the spirit rises, the rhythm flows — it slips naturally wherever music goes.

M012.name: Blank Verse
M012.effect: Gain 2 Block. This card can be placed in any Sijo slot.
M012.effect_upgraded: Gain 4 Block. Can be placed in any Sijo slot.
M012.flavor: Empty space is part of the poem too — one who fills the void completes the Sijo.

D001.name: Qi Cultivation
D001.flavor: Steady the breath, gather the Qi — power charges in the stillness.

D002.name: Hand Seal
D002.effect: Gain 2 Block. The next Attack card you play this turn deals +4 damage.
D002.effect_upgraded: Gain 3 Block. Next Attack deals +6 damage.
D002.flavor: Form the seal at your fingertips — the next technique surges with power.

D003.name: Mantra
D003.effect: Deal 4 damage to ALL enemies. If you have gained Qi this turn, deal 3 more damage.
D003.effect_upgraded: Deal 6 damage to ALL enemies. Qi bonus becomes +4.
D003.flavor: The mantra rings across the battlefield — the Daoist shockwave sweeps all foes.

D004.name: Talisman Strike
D004.effect: Deal 5 damage. Apply 3 Burn to the target. (Burn: take Burn damage at turn end, decreases by 1 each turn.)
D004.flavor: Hurl the flame-imbued talisman — Daoist fire sets the enemy ablaze.

D005.name: Teleportation
D005.effect: Draw 3 cards. Card costs are reduced by 1 this turn (min 0).
D005.flavor: Fold space, cross a thousand leagues in one step — all arts rest in the palm.

D006.name: Mountain Collapse
D006.effect: Deal 40 damage. Next turn, lose 2 Qi.
D006.flavor: Like a mountain crumbling — one technique sweeps everything away.

D007.name: Qi Strike
D007.flavor: Form the seal, launch Qi from the fingertips — the Sorcerer's basic strike needs no blade.

D008.name: Great Qi
D008.flavor: Breathe deep the heavenly energy — the whole body brims with Qi.

D009.name: Qi Explosion
D009.effect: Deal 4 damage per Qi gained this turn (min 8).
D009.effect_upgraded: Deal 5 damage per Qi gained this turn (min 10).
D009.flavor: Release the stored Qi in an instant — explosive energy blasts the enemy away.

D010.name: Five Energies
D010.effect: Gain 1 Qi. The next Qi-subtype card you play this turn costs 1 less.
D010.effect_upgraded: Gain 1 Qi. Next Qi-subtype card costs 2 less.
D010.flavor: The five elemental energies gather at the fingertips — the next technique flows more easily.

D011.name: Heavenly Qi
D011.effect: For the rest of combat, gain 1 extra Qi at the start of each turn.
D011.effect_upgraded: Gain 2 extra Qi at the start of each turn for the rest of combat.
D011.flavor: Become one with the Qi of Heaven — it wells up on its own every moment.

D012.name: Qi Flow
D012.flavor: Ride the flow of Qi — everything in the world snaps into sharp clarity.

D013.name: Qi Gathering
D013.flavor: Draw energies from all directions to one point — maximal Qi waits to detonate.

D014.name: Poison Mist
D014.effect: Apply 2 Poison to ALL enemies. (Poison: take Poison damage at turn end, decreases by 1 each turn.)
D014.flavor: Poison seeps like fog — it dyes the whole battlefield before anyone notices.

D015.name: Hex
D015.effect: Apply Curse to an enemy. Curse: take 3 damage at the start of each turn for 3 turns.
D015.flavor: Once cursed, there is no escape — it burrows deeper with every passing moment.

D016.name: Chaos Talisman
D016.effect: Apply 3 Burn and 2 Weakened to an enemy.
D016.flavor: Flame and chaos intertwined — the talisman burns and destabilizes all at once.

D017.name: Black Flame
D017.effect: Deal 6 damage. If target has 2+ Burn, deal 4 more. If target has 2+ Poison, deal 4 more.
D017.effect_upgraded: Deal 8 damage. Burn bonus +5. Poison bonus +5.
D017.flavor: Poison and fire merge into black flame — it scorches wounds already burning.

D018.name: Five Poisons
D018.effect: Apply 4 Poison and 3 Burn to ALL enemies simultaneously.
D018.flavor: Five poisons mingle with flame — a cursed fog of death spreads across the field.

D019.name: Hex Binding
D019.effect: Apply 2 Vulnerable to an enemy for this combat. The target's DoT damage (Poison, Burn, Curse) is ×1.5.
D019.flavor: Bind the foe with a hex — the poison and fire bore even deeper.

D020.name: Gumiho Summon
D020.effect: Summon a Gumiho. For 3 turns, deal 5 damage to an enemy at the start of each turn.
D020.flavor: When the nine-tailed fox appears — the tide of battle turns.

D021.name: Azure Dragon's Qi
D021.effect: Deal 10 damage. Summon an Azure Dragon token. Token: recover 1 Qi at the end of each turn.
D021.effect_upgraded: Deal 12 damage. Token recovers 2 Qi per turn.
D021.flavor: Channel the Azure Dragon into the strike — the dragon's breath returns as Qi.

D022.name: White Tiger Strike
D022.effect: Deal 22 damage. If a summon or token is active, deal 8 more damage.
D022.flavor: The White Tiger lunges and roars — heaven and earth tremble.

D023.name: Mountain God's Descent
D023.effect: Summon the Mountain God. For 3 turns, gain 5 Block and 1 Qi at the start of each turn.
D023.effect_upgraded: Lasts 4 turns. Gain 7 Block and 2 Qi per turn.
D023.flavor: When the Mountain God descends — earth's energy wraps the body, heaven's Qi flows in.

D024.name: Scarecrow
D024.effect: Summon a Scarecrow. It absorbs 1 hit, then vanishes. On death, draw 1 card.
D024.flavor: Even a straw figure serves its purpose on the battlefield — it leaves a path as it fades.

D025.name: Dokkaebi's Call
D025.effect: Deal 8 damage to ALL enemies. If a summon or token is active, deal 5 more to all.
D025.effect_upgraded: Deal 10 to ALL. Summon bonus becomes +7.
D025.flavor: Unleash a Dokkaebi upon the battlefield — chaos sweeps every foe away.

G001.name: Battle Stance
G001.effect: Summon 1 ally. Gain 2 Qi. ally: absorbs 1 hit then vanishes; on death, recover 1 Qi.
G001.flavor: Post a soldier ahead — deflect the blade aimed at you.

G002.name: Charge
G002.effect: Spend 2 Qi. Deal 10 damage. If you have 1+ ally, deal 5 more.
G002.flavor: Break through the line at full force — nothing stands in the path of the charge.

G003.name: Encirclement
G003.effect: Apply Surrounded (2 turns) to ALL enemies. Gain 1 Qi. (Surrounded: attack damage -25%.)
G003.flavor: Enclose them from all sides — the trapped enemy cannot fight at full strength.

G004.name: Crane Wing Strike
G004.effect: Spend 3 Qi. Deal 8 damage to ALL enemies. Deal 3 more per ally you control.
G004.flavor: Wings spread wide — the combat tactics crushes every foe in its embrace.

G005.name: Iron Bulwark
G005.effect: Gain 18 Block. Summon 2 allys. Gain 2 Qi. Token summons are doubled this turn.
G005.effect_upgraded: Gain 22 Block. Summon 4 Tokens. Gain 3 Qi.
G005.flavor: The combat tactics that conquered the realm — an impenetrable wall of shields and spears.

G006.name: Infantry Advance
G006.flavor: Infantry presses forward — pace by pace, the battle tilts our way.

G007.name: Ambush
G007.flavor: Strike from the shadows — a hidden soldier buys precious time.

G008.name: Three-Army Deployment
G008.flavor: Three armies in position — the battlefield belongs to us.

G009.name: Tactical Manual
G009.effect: For this combat, gain 1 extra Qi each time you play a Combat Tactics card.
G009.effect_upgraded: Gain 2 extra Qi per Combat Tactics card.
G009.flavor: The manual holds all combat tacticss — mastery turns every move into advantage.

G010.name: Iron Cavalry Charge
G010.effect: Spend 3 Qi. Deal 18 damage. If you have a ally, deal 4 more.
G010.flavor: Iron-clad cavalry thunders forward — the enemy has nowhere to run.

G011.name: Camp
G011.effect: Gain 6 Block. At the start of next turn, gain 2 Qi.
G011.effect_upgraded: Gain 8 Block. Gain 3 Qi next turn.
G011.flavor: Set up camp and hold the line — tomorrow the charge renews.

G012.name: Cannon Fire
G012.effect: Deal 6 damage to ALL enemies. If you have a ally, deal 3 more to all.
G012.flavor: The cannon roars — thunder shakes the field.

G013.name: Battle Cry
G013.flavor: One mighty shout — the entire army's morale ignites.

G014.name: Reversal
G014.effect: Deal 2 damage per current Qi (min 6). Does not consume Qi.
G014.flavor: Turn desperation into fury — the harder the press, the fiercer the counter.

G015.name: Indomitable Will
G015.effect: Increase max Qi by 5 for this combat. Gain 3 Qi.
G015.flavor: An unbreakable will knows no limit — the body exceeds its own boundaries.

G016.name: Last Stand
G016.effect: Spend ALL Qi. Deal 3 damage per Qi spent (min 0).
G016.flavor: Everything — pour it all into this one moment.

G017.name: Solo Charge
G017.effect: Deal 6 damage. Optionally spend 2 Qi to deal 4 more.
G017.flavor: A lone warrior charges the enemy line — and the line breaks.

G018.name: Peerless
G018.effect: Deal 20 damage. Spend ALL Qi; deal 4 more per Qi spent.
G018.effect_upgraded: Deal 25 base. Bonus per Qi becomes 5.
G018.flavor: Unmatched under heaven — one strike shatters all.

G019.name: Defensive Combat Tactics
G019.flavor: Shield wall locked — no gap for the enemy to exploit.

G020.name: Thrust
G020.flavor: A single precise thrust — simple, true, lethal.

G021.name: Counter
G021.effect: Gain 5 Block. The next hit you take this combat deals 3 damage back to the attacker.
G021.flavor: Absorb the blow — and return it twice as hard.

G022.name: Continuous Slash
G022.flavor: One slash, then another — relentless rhythm that wears the enemy down.

G023.name: Iron Wall Defense
G023.flavor: A wall of iron — not a single blade shall pass.

G024.name: Breakthrough
G024.effect: Deal 12 damage. If the target is Vulnerable, deal 8 more.
G024.flavor: Find the gap — then shatter it completely.

G025.name: Veteran General
G025.effect: Increase max Qi by 3. For this combat, draw 1 card whenever a ally dies.
G025.effect_upgraded: Max Qi +5. Draw 2 cards per Token death.
G025.flavor: A hundred battles, a hundred victories — every fallen soldier teaches a lesson.

W001.name: Memorial
W001.flavor: Words strike harder than swords — a well-placed memorial topples ministers.

W002.name: Impeachment
W002.effect: Deal 10 damage. Optionally spend 1 knowledge to apply 2 Vulnerable. (Vulnerable: take 50% more damage.)
W002.flavor: The scroll of impeachment lands — the accused staggers under the weight of truth.

W003.name: Petition
W003.effect: Spend ALL knowledge. Deal knowledge×3 damage to ALL enemies (min 6).
W003.flavor: Ten thousand voices behind a single petition — the pressure is irresistible.

W004.name: Royal Lecture
W004.flavor: Enlighten the court — knowledge fortifies as much as armor.

W005.name: Royal Edict
W005.flavor: The edict carries royal authority — all must yield before the command.

W006.name: Study
W006.flavor: A scholar never ceases learning — each page read sharpens the mind further.

W007.name: Investigation
W007.effect: Gain 2 knowledge. The next card you play this turn costs 1 less (min 0).
W007.effect_upgraded: Gain 3 knowledge. Next card costs 1 less.
W007.flavor: Investigate thoroughly — insight unlocks paths hidden to others.

W008.name: knowledge
W008.flavor: Broad learning across all disciplines — a scholar's arsenal knows no bounds.

W009.name: Royal Procession
W009.flavor: The royal entourage moves with ceremony and purpose — order itself becomes a shield.

W010.name: Evasive Rhetoric
W010.effect: Gain 5 Block. If 3+ Sijo slots are filled this turn, gain 2 more knowledge.
W010.flavor: Deflect with words, deflect with motion — rhetoric and footwork are one.

W011.name: Loyal Counsel
W011.flavor: Earnest advice may sting — but the kingdom stands stronger for it.

W012.name: Debate
W012.effect: Deal 8 damage. Optionally spend 1 knowledge to deal 6 more.
W012.flavor: Crush the argument — and with it, the opponent.

W013.name: Argumentation
W013.effect: Gain 3 knowledge. Draw effects are increased by 1 this turn.
W013.flavor: An airtight argument — logic itself becomes a weapon.

W014.name: Anthology
W014.effect: For this combat, increase max knowledge by 2 (up to 8). Gain 2 knowledge.
W014.flavor: Volumes of wisdom bound together — the compiled knowledge of generations.

W015.name: Royal Permission
W015.effect: Spend ALL knowledge. Deal knowledge×5 damage to one target (min 10).
W015.flavor: Royal authority unleashed — a single word from the throne ends all defiance.

W016.name: Censure
W016.effect: Apply 2 Weakened to a target enemy. (Weakened: next attacks deal 25% less.)
W016.flavor: A public censure strips the enemy of confidence and power.

W017.name: Bold Scheme
W017.effect: Apply 3 Weakened and 2 Vulnerable to a target enemy.
W017.flavor: A daring stratagem — sap their attack, expose their defense.

W018.name: Dismissal
W018.effect: Deal 8 damage. Apply Dismissed to the target. (Dismissed: attack power -3 for 3 turns.)
W018.flavor: Stripped of rank and authority — the dismissed official is diminished in all ways.

W019.name: Remonstration
W019.effect: Draw 1 card. Apply 2 Vulnerable to the next enemy hit this turn.
W019.flavor: A fervent remonstration cracks even the most stubborn resolve.

W020.name: Exile
W020.effect: Remove all buffs from a target enemy. Apply 4 Weakened.
W020.flavor: Exile strips everything — titles, power, pride.

W021.name: Perfect Virtue
W021.flavor: The virtuous scholar stands unmoved — righteousness itself is armor.

W022.name: Noble Man
W022.effect: Gain 12 Block. Optionally spend 1 knowledge to gain 6 more Block.
W022.flavor: A true noble man faces any storm without flinching.

W023.name: Clean Governance
W023.effect: Gain 5 Block. If your current knowledge is 0, gain 3 more Block.
W023.flavor: Incorruptible governance — clear as dawn, strong as stone.

W024.name: Right Path
W024.effect: For this combat, gain 1 knowledge each time you play a Defense card.
W024.flavor: The righteous path turns every act of defense into a lesson learned.

W025.name: Great Righteousness
W025.effect: Gain 3 knowledge. Gain 8 Block. Draw 2 cards.
W025.effect_upgraded: Gain 4 knowledge. Gain 10 Block. Draw 3 cards.
W025.flavor: Great righteousness needs no justification — it speaks for itself in might and virtue.

R001.name: Horseshoe
R001.effect: At the start of combat, immediately gain 5 Block.

R002.name: Peace Talisman
R002.effect: Buffs applied to yourself last 1 additional turn.

R003.name: Lucky Coin
R003.effect: Gain 10 extra gold after each combat victory.

R004.name: Phoenix Feather
R004.effect: Draw 1 extra card each time your draw pile is shuffled.

R005.name: Red Ginseng Root
R005.effect: Recover 8 HP after defeating an Elite.

R006.name: Bodyguard Sword
R006.effect: At the start of combat, max Qi increases by 1 for this combat.

R007.name: Four Books
R007.effect: Draw 1 extra card when you play your first card each turn.

R008.name: Dongui Bogam
R008.effect: Apply 1 extra stack when applying Poison.

R009.name: Shaman Bell
R009.effect: Gain 2 extra Spirit Power at the start of combat.

R010.name: Horn Bow
R010.effect: Max Arrow capacity +3. Gain 2 extra Arrows at the start of combat.

R011.name: Merchant Ledger
R011.effect: Gain 35 extra gold each time you enter a shop. (Max 2 times per run.)

R012.name: Royal Inspector's Plaque
R012.effect: At the start of combat, apply 2 Vulnerable to the enemy with the most HP.

R013.name: Manpasikjeok
R013.effect: Recover 25% of max HP when entering a Boss combat.

R014.name: Cursed Helmet
R014.effect: Attack cards also apply 1 Bleed to the target. However, you start each combat with 3 Poison.

R015.name: Three-Legged Crow Feather
R015.effect: Gain 1 extra Qi at the start of each turn. However, 2 Curse cards are added to your starting deck.

RS001.name: Talisman Pouch
RS001.effect: At the start of combat, add 1 random Talisman card to your hand.

RS002.name: Royal Warrant
RS002.effect: Automatically summon 1 ally at the start of combat.

RS003.name: Destiny
RS003.effect: Gain 2 knowledge at the start of combat.

R016.name: Herb Bundle
R016.effect: Remove all Poison stacks from yourself at the start of combat.

R017.name: Worn Shield
R017.effect: Gain 2 Block at the start of each turn.

R018.name: Nameless Dagger
R018.effect: Recover 1 Qi immediately whenever you kill an enemy.

R019.name: Axe Talisman
R019.effect: Recover 1 extra Qi each time you complete the First Verse (2 slots).

R020.name: Diamond
R020.effect: Gain 8 Block at the start of combat.

R021.name: Dragon's Horn
R021.effect: Recover 1 Qi each time a card is Exhausted.

R022.name: Obsidian Seal
R022.effect: Reduce the cost of removing a card at the shop by 25 gold.

R023.name: Moonlight Mirror
R023.effect: Draw 1 extra card each time you complete a Sijo. (1 → 2 cards drawn.)

R024.name: Blood Oath
R024.effect: Gain 15 extra gold after defeating an Elite.

R025.name: Five Elements Combat Tactics
R025.effect: At the start of combat, gain Strength +1 and max Qi +1 for this combat. Resets after combat.

R026.name: Star Map
R026.effect: Sijo completion bonus becomes ×2.5 instead of ×2.

R027.name: Royal Seal
R027.effect: Gain 15 Block immediately at the start of Boss combat.

R028.name: Immortal Talisman
R028.effect: Once per run: survive lethal damage with 1 HP.

RM001.name: Military Manual
RM001.effect: Gain 1 extra Qi each time you play a Combat Tactics card.

RW001.name: Royal Portrait
RW001.effect: Recover 5% of max HP each time you fully spend your knowledge. (Scholar only.)

RD001.name: Immortal's Cinnabar
RD001.effect: Gain 1 extra Qi each time you play a Spell card. (Sorcerer only.)

RD002.name: Yin-Yang Token
RD002.effect: Draw 1 card each time a summoned token dies. (Sorcerer only.)

RS004.name: Sijo Anthology
RS004.effect: On the turn after completing a Sijo, carry over 1 Qi to the next turn. (Exception to the no-carryover rule.)

RS005.name: Rhythm Drum
RS005.effect: Recover 1 Qi immediately each time you play a Wildcard (M011 / M012).

RB001.name: Yi Mu-ryeong's Seal
RB001.effect: Removing cards at the shop costs 0 gold.

RB002.name: Twin-Head Tiger Hide
RB002.effect: Gain Strength +3 at the start of combat. Resets after combat.

RB003.name: Traitor Minister's Official Seal
RB003.effect: Sijo completion bonus becomes ×3 instead of ×2. (Does not stack with Star Map R026; max ×3.)

act_1.name: Act I — Hanyang
act_1.description: The capital of Joseon. A city of corrupt officials, street ruffians, and restless spirits.

E001.name: Street Thug
E001.description: A reckless brawler from the Hanyang alleys. Fast and rough, but rash.

E002.name: Corrupt Officer
E002.description: A crooked constable armed with a shield and club.

E003.name: Vengeful Spirit
E003.description: A ghost still burning with earthly grievances.

E004.name: Dokkaebi
E004.description: A mischievous goblin spirit lurking in the city.

E005.name: Officer Captain
E005.description: A commanding officer who leads the patrol.

E006.name: Evil Spirit
E006.description: A malevolent spirit that attacks the living.

E007.name: Corrupt Official
E007.description: A greedy government official who exploits the common folk.

EL001.name: Imugi
EL001.description: A serpentine dragon that failed to ascend — bitter and powerful.

EL002.name: Prison Warden
EL002.description: A ruthless warden of the royal prison.

EL003.name: Shaman
EL003.description: A powerful shaman wielding spiritual curses.

B_ACT1_FINAL.name: Minister Yi Mu-ryeong
B_ACT1_FINAL.description: A corrupt minister orchestrating the conspiracy against the throne.

B_ACT1_MID.name: Constabulary Commander
B_ACT1_MID.description: The chief of the corrupt Hanyang constabulary.

B_ACT1_ALT.name: Grand Shaman Cheon-ryeong
B_ACT1_ALT.description: A master shaman commanding powerful spirits.

act_2.name: Act II — Jirisan
act_2.description: The sacred mountain. Home to bandits, spirits, and ancient powers.

E201.name: Bandit
E201.description: A mountain outlaw who ambushes travelers on the pass.

E202.name: Maiden Ghost
E202.description: The spirit of a young woman who died with unresolved regrets.

E203.name: Temple Warrior Monk
E203.description: A monk-soldier defending the mountain temple.

E204.name: Viper
E204.description: A venomous mountain serpent guarding its den.

E205.name: Mountain Spirit
E205.description: An elemental spirit born from the mountain's energy.

E206.name: Daoist Practitioner
E206.description: A rogue Daoist sorcerer wielding forbidden arts.

E207.name: Wild Tiger
E207.description: A ferocious tiger prowling the mountain paths.

EL201.name: White Tiger
EL201.description: The divine white tiger, guardian of the western mountain.

EL202.name: Bandit Chief
EL202.description: The ruthless leader of the mountain bandit clan.

EL203.name: Gumiho
EL203.description: A nine-tailed fox spirit with mesmerizing and deadly powers.

B_ACT2_FINAL.name: Twin-Head Tiger
B_ACT2_FINAL.description: A monstrous two-headed tiger, lord of Jirisan.

B_ACT2_MID.name: Bandit Fortress Chief
B_ACT2_MID.description: The warlord commanding the fortified mountain stronghold.

B_ACT2_ALT.name: Great Gumiho
B_ACT2_ALT.description: The ancient gumiho queen, wielder of illusion and destruction.

act_3.name: Act III — Royal Palace
act_3.description: The palace under siege. Traitors walk the halls and the throne is in danger.

E301.name: Rebel Warrior
E301.description: A traitor's mercenary soldier fighting inside the palace.

E302.name: Rebel Official
E302.description: A traitorous scholar official serving the conspiracy.

E303.name: Assassin
E303.description: A shadowy killer sent by the rebel faction.

E304.name: Royal Eunuch
E304.description: A palace eunuch turned spy for the traitors.

E305.name: Royal Guard
E305.description: An elite palace guard — but whose side are they on?

E306.name: Messenger of Death
E306.description: A supernatural being that reaps the lives of the fallen.

E307.name: Cursed Apparition
E307.description: A spirit raised by the traitor's dark rituals.

EL301.name: Rebel General
EL301.description: The rebel army's field commander inside the palace.

EL302.name: Royal Inspector
EL302.description: A royal inspector whose loyalties are unclear.

EL303.name: Imugi King
EL303.description: The monstrous king of the Imugi, summoned by the traitors.

B_ACT3_FINAL.name: Traitor Minister
B_ACT3_FINAL.description: The mastermind behind the rebellion — the final enemy.

B_ACT3_MID.name: Rebel Assassination Squad Leader
B_ACT3_MID.description: The captain of the traitor's elite assassination unit.

1.name: Act I
1.description: The capital city, rife with corruption and restless spirits.

2.name: Act II
